parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, attached to the front of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage compartment inside the table.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A second cabinet door made of MDF, forming the other half of the front access panel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the opposite side of the storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A third cabinet door, similar to the others, made of MDF.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as an additional access panel for internal storage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat plywood panel forming the back of the table cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and encloses the rear of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: Another back panel section made of plywood, part of the rear enclosure.
parts.Functional_description: It reinforces the back structure of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel made of solid wood, forming one side of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and defines the cabinet boundary.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: The opposite vertical side panel made of solid wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural stability and defines the opposite side of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Divider Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical divider panel made of plywood, located inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal storage space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Divider Panel
parts.Basic_description: Another vertical divider panel made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional internal separation and support.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A bottom panel made of solid wood forming the base of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and connects to the legs.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A wooden leg supporting one corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It provides elevation and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden leg supporting another corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It provides elevation and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A third wooden leg supporting the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides elevation and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A fourth wooden leg completing the table’s support system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides elevation and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Top Panel (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A secondary top panel made of solid wood, located beneath the tabletop.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional support and connection between the tabletop and cabinet frame.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The main tabletop surface made of solid wood.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary working or placing surface of the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
